# CityYoYo

> CityYoYo is a free AI audio city guide app for iOS and Android. It offers two ways to explore a city on foot: Explore Mode, where tapping any place on a map instantly generates an AI narration for that spot, and Tour Mode, a hands-free walking mode that automatically narrates nearby places as you walk, controllable with AirPods/headphone gestures. Narrations are generated on the spot rather than pre-recorded, so it works for any place worldwide, not just famous landmarks. Offline city packs are available, and the app supports six languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, and French. The website (cityyoyo.com) is also available in all six languages, under /es/, /ko/, /zh/, /pt/, and /fr/ (English at the root).

## ChinaWalk

> ChinaWalk is CityYoYo's sister app, built specifically for foreign travelers exploring China. Same tap-to-hear AI narration as CityYoYo, tuned for the two things that make a China trip different: the network and the language. It works in mainland China without a VPN (tested on the ground, on local carriers and wifi). It auto-translates both the AI narration and the place names shown on the map into the user's chosen language (English, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, or French), so travelers aren't stuck reading Chinese-only labels or running a separate translation app. Nothing is pre-curated: tapping a hutong, a neighborhood teahouse, or an unmarked alley generates a narration the same way it would for a landmark like the Forbidden City or the Bund. Offline city maps are available for Beijing, Shanghai, Xi'an, Chengdu, Guilin, and any other city in China. Free on iOS and Android.

- [ChinaWalk landing page](https://cityyoyo.com/chinawalk/): Full overview — the VPN/language/landmark-coverage differentiators, how Explore Mode and Tour Mode work in China, popular Chinese cities covered, screenshots, and FAQ. Also available in [Spanish](https://cityyoyo.com/es/chinawalk/), [Korean](https://cityyoyo.com/ko/chinawalk/), [Chinese](https://cityyoyo.com/zh/chinawalk/), [Portuguese](https://cityyoyo.com/pt/chinawalk/), and [French](https://cityyoyo.com/fr/chinawalk/).
- [App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/chinawalk-ai-china-tour-guide/id6767760457): iOS download.
- [Google Play listing](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cityyoyo.audio.china): Android download.
